description: Reusable minimal real-QVT 2-D ICP electron particle + electron-energy diffusion diagnostic for isolating geometry, energy-dependent transport-table lookup, and matched thermal wall-loss behavior before adding drift, Poisson, reactions, or volumetric energy sources.
objective: Establish a reusable 2-D ICP electron diffusion baseline with solved electron energy, energy-dependent table lookup, and matched particle/energy thermal wall losses.
target_claims: electron particle and electron-energy diffusion run on the real ICP RZ plasma geometry without electrostatic coupling
thermal particle and energy wall losses at zero sheath potential deplete their respective conserved inventories
solved mean electron energy drives local electron diffusivity through the production transport-table lookup path
constraints: electron particle continuity solved in log-molar form
electron energy density solved as c_epsilon in eV mol/m^3
mean electron energy derived as c_epsilon/c_e and not frozen
electron particle and energy diffusivities obtained from electron_moments.txt through PhysicsElectronClosureMaterial
Joule heating and volumetric electron-energy sources disabled
all named plasma boundaries use matched grounded thermal particle/energy collection with sheath potential fixed to 0 V
no electric field or volumetric source
